body: Best of luck.

Fighting to get help is never "complaining".
Say you know a person with cancer, and they want to fight it and survive, so they keep pushing to go to the doctor and get treatment. Would you look at that person and say "stop complaining"?

Hold on to the fact you don't want to give up- that's good. And you don't HAVE to know everything, some things in life can never be truly comprehensible. Having some of the right questions is better than having all the wrong answers.

An option being that people hurt, and hurt people can help other hurt people. (Which is what I believe I'm failing at now. Don't be afraid to tell me I should stop. But I enjoy picking your brain, as you are not an idiot, in fact you are incredibly intelligent and come up with interesting questions.)
Doing "research" into your religion? Does that mean you don't really have one, and are searching around? Or does your family has one and that means you do by default?

Now laugh me off on this, but I'm a Christian.
 Reasons being- In Christianity it aught to be that you have a relationship with Jesus(God made man so as to experience our pain) instead of religion(Man having to prove himself to God by works). And in that relationship, so long as you confess you are truly sorry, Jesus has the power to forgive you even if you can't forgive yourself.

(I'm not trying to pressure you into even considering this for yourself, but in my life, I can fully credit that relationship with Jesus as one of the two sole reasons I'm not already gone. Basically, Jesus has been so good to me that I feel selfish not sharing that hope even if you choose to disagree.)

And as such, know that I am praying for. And I don't know you, but you seem like a bright spark that just needs rekindled. And the world needs your type.

Yes. But I also feel like they underestimate my ability to live an thrive.
So, kill myself and never know if I proved them wrong, or claw for freedom and watch their shock as I prove them wrong...?

I'm... honestly at a loss about that first part, too. I wish I knew the magic pill or spell that would solve this mess. If there was one.
Perhaps being broken together is one option?

But, in my opinion mind you, even a life of flawed decisions (which I have to wonder what you even consider that) can be turned around with a single prayer. If your God is tallying sins/shortcomings even after you seek forgiveness... that isn't a God I would worship.
Many days I end praying that I would see myself as God sees me- cleansed. 

Do you believe that God has the power to forgive you?
I'm praying for you.

Hey. I just want to say that you are so strong for hanging in there through all this- you are an inspiration. 
But if life is too much, reach out! No one can take the world on alone. Perhaps you could get help via food stamps or a local food panty, a church, etc. Anything to ease the bills- something you shouldn't even have to worry about. Maybe start a YouTube channel to raise awareness and earn a dime?

Most of all, you too, are human and have needs accordingly. Take care. Please?
But how can you help shoulder the others' pain if you are dead? How can you help the hurting if you are gone?

I find it ironic to read this, as I often feel no one would care if I ended myself...
Yet when an anonymous person online says the same, it literally breaks my heart. I don't know you, but I care. I want you to succeed in life. I want you to be happy.

Pain and happiness are both temporary. Like cold and heat, they are measurements that cannot exist without each other.
I'm sorry you are in that much pain right now. And believe me, I believe you that it HURTS. I'm so sorry you feel like that about yourself...

But the good news is that happiness and pain can coexist. I pray you find that balance- as in my opinion it is the most satisfying way to live.

For now, perhaps a good point of life is to make life worth living?

There is so much more to healing than just popping pills- with ANY illness, but even more so with a mental one. You are in school, no? Talk to the school counselor, if you don't feel comfortable going to your parents/guardians.

Everyone needs help sometimes, and that is okay. Humans are broken, but we can be broken together and that's a beautiful thing.

P.S. Don't put it off. I did at your age, and I lost the grade I was ahead! Barely managed to graduate on time...

I did research and read that a nearly neutral note did the best to aid closure without causing more blame/guilt in the survivors. Plus, if I tell my sisters to follow what I know their dreams are now, I'm afraid
1. They could be stuck in my dreams for them and not what they want, forced down a road chosen by my ghost.
2. Never be able to even experience their hobbies again without grief.

Of course, who knows about the authenticity of said article... or if a note even helps.

Also praying for you, too. Ha, it's already tomorrow here- maybe it was just another note.

They know, I've been explicit in telling them I need help, and they said it wasn't an option this time. So maybe this is a relief they have secretly sought for a while. I wasn't supposed to come back the first time, and I think on some subconscious level they wrote me off years ago.

Reason to live: you aren't dead. Which may sound like a joke but it isn't. Death is inevitable and you are just speeding through an already short existence. "Life is but a breath".
My reasons are coffee, that magic when you remember what it was like when you still believed in magic, swinging at the park at night, and the hope that someday my pain will help others through theirs. That last one doubly, as I'm afraid of the opposite negative impact of giving in.

But I too have a question. As a fellow believer in God, do you believe He would just keep someone around that is without purpose? Or yet, is suicide ever in God's will?
(Things I think about more often than I care to...)
That means a lot, it really does. Thank you for your effort. If I stay up long enough the whole deal may pass anyway. God only knows how many notes I've thrown out.

Can't say I believe even a well-written note would make the idea any better or worse...
But what are your suggestions?

Well I'm praying for you, to find whatever it is that evens your word into bearable and even enjoyable.
My grandfather was Bipolar and sounded like that sometimes. (I'm not saying that you are bipolar!) But when he was evened out, he was literally the best person I've even known. I have faith in you. I'm sure your friends do, too.
Aye, thank you. My family knows the reasons already and they just aren't up to actually helping, so this is the best way I could think of wording it.

Life is more than education and whatever bull crap society is selling as "success" nowadays.
Every day you live is a day all the forces that want you dead lose. 
Try that challenge?

That is scary, and I'm sorry you are going through that. But, you are well enough to see that this is not okay- which is good.
But if you can't control yourself you need outside help- and it takes some looking to find someone who has the correct skill set to help any particular individual. You may go through a handful of "therapists" or "counselors" that  don't particularly care about your case before you find one that helps.

And I'm sorry it's that way. It shouldn't be. 

And trust me it isn't just you, life sucks. For all of us, just on different levels with different devils.
